title: Understanding the P-Trap Water Seal
description: The P-trap is a critical component of sink drainage systems, designed to hold a standing pool of water within its curved dip. This persistent water barrier blocks foul sewer gases, volatile organic compounds, and pests from migrating from the drainage network up into occupied spaces. Every time the faucet runs, incoming wastewater flushes out the old water and replenishes the seal automatically. Understanding how the trap seal works helps plumbers troubleshoot dry traps, siphoning issues, and foul drain odors effectively during routine maintenance and installations.

Understanding the P-Trap Water Seal

The P-trap is a critical component of sink drainage systems, designed to hold a standing pool of water within its curved dip. This persistent water barrier blocks foul sewer gases, volatile organic compounds, and pests from migrating from the drainage network up into occupied spaces. Every time the faucet runs, incoming wastewater flushes out the old water and replenishes the seal automatically. Understanding how the trap seal works helps plumbers troubleshoot dry traps, siphoning issues, and foul drain odors effectively during routine maintenance and installations.
